lines.native: Benvenuto. Welcome to il mercato. A greeting and your name, please. This entrance has standards.
lines.translation: Welcome. Welcome to the market. A greeting and your name, please. This entrance has standards.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from the archway’s keystone. The stonework waits with the patience of an unpaid clerk.

lines.native: Ciao! Benvenuto al mercato. Your greeting is approved. Your name, however, remains conspicuously absent. Who are you?
lines.translation: Hello! Welcome to the market. Your greeting is approved. Your name, however, remains conspicuously absent. Who are you?
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides out of Portia’s keystone. The blank name field has acquired an accusatory underline.

lines.native: Piacere, Sam. Benvenuto al mercato. Your introduction is approved. Any interest in the name of your hardworking archway?
lines.translation: Nice to meet you, Sam. Welcome to the market. Your introduction is approved. Any interest in the name of your hardworking archway?

lines.native: Mi chiamo Portia. Piacere, Sam! You asked. How unexpectedly lovely. Your paperwork is complete. Benvenuto al mercato.
lines.translation: My name is Portia. Nice to meet you, Sam! You asked. How unexpectedly lovely. Your paperwork is complete. Welcome to the market.
lines.narrative: The visitors’ book retreats into her keystone. Portia briefly forgets to look like a load-bearing regulation.

lines.native: Buongiorno! Tutto prosciutto! Even the hat. Certified ham. Che cosa desidera? My scales alone shall judge.
lines.translation: Good morning! Everything is ham! Even the hat. Certified ham. What would you like? My scales alone shall judge.
lines.narrative: Mortimer beams behind the butcher’s stall. He places his hat on the scales; professional certainty has its checks.

lines.native: Prosciutto, certo! Ma è sempre prosciutto. A certified ham choice! You need a different meat, named in Italian. Che cosa desidera?
lines.translation: Ham, certainly! But it is still ham. A certified ham choice! You need a different meat, named in Italian. What would you like?
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your request. The scales confirm that it contains precisely no surprises.

lines.native: Salame, certo! Ha ragione lei! Certified ham-adjacent. My hat remains prosciutto. Quanto ne desidera? La bilancia aspetta!
lines.translation: Salami, certainly! You are right! Certified ham-adjacent. My hat remains ham. How much would you like? The scales are waiting!
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your correct answer. The scales approve, which he takes as a minor personal betrayal.

lines.native: Un momento! Manca la quantità. A unit alone? My scales refuse to guess. Quanto salame desidera?
lines.translation: One moment! The quantity is missing. A unit alone? My scales refuse to guess. How much salami would you like?
lines.narrative: Mortimer places a solitary weight on the scales. They decline to infer a shopping intention.

lines.native: Due etti, perfetto! Ecco il suo salame. Certified ham-adjacent, precisely weighed. Grazie! My scales approve; frankly, so do I.
lines.translation: Two hundred grams, perfect! Here is your salami. Certified ham-adjacent, precisely weighed. Thank you! My scales approve; frankly, so do I.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs the salami, then your courtesy. Both meet the required standard; only one goes in the paper.

lines.native: Ciao! Come stai? Riddle me this—actually, five more minutes. What moved over there? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Hi! How are you? Riddle me this—actually, five more minutes. What moved over there? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain dribbles with municipal confidence. Flick appears at the edge of your vision; looking directly at it produces only a tiny firecracker and a disappointing amount of smoke.

lines.native: Guardo! Ma dove? That tells me to look, not stop moving. Come on, pin me down with an Italian command! Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I'm looking! But where? That tells me to look, not stop moving. Come on, pin me down with an Italian command! Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick follows a drifting leaf. The leaf has offered no leadership credentials.

lines.native: Va bene, mi fermo! Attention span: suspiciously powerful. Dove devo andare? Riddle me—ooh, a spark. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: All right, I’m stopping! Attention span: suspiciously powerful. Where should I go? Riddle me—ooh, a spark. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker continues without it, having received no instructions to the contrary.

lines.native: Non capisco! Dove devo andare? Your direction is in English. Italian, please—riddle me this—oh, shiny. Non oggi! Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I don't understand! Where should I go? Your direction is in English. Italian, please—riddle me this—oh, shiny. Not today! Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick appears at the edge of your vision, where accountability has poor reception.

lines.native: A sinistra, sì! Sono qui! Direction: ten out of ten. Che ore sono? È troppo presto! Riddle me—wait. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! I’m here! Direction: ten out of ten. What time is it? It’s too early! Riddle me—wait. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick darts left, remaining firmly in the corner of your vision. A tiny firecracker announces that the fountain’s broken clock has acquired an excuse.

lines.native: Adesso, va bene! Ma che ore sono? L'orologio è fermo! Now: ten out of ten. Time still missing. Riddle me—ooh, sparks. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Now, all right! But what time is it? The clock has stopped! Now: ten out of ten. Time still missing. Riddle me—ooh, sparks. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops just outside your field of vision. The fountain’s clock remains committed to being decorative.

lines.native: È l'una, sì! Hai ragione! Clock skills: ten out of ten. Ma possiamo aspettare! Riddle me—wait, shiny. Perché tanta fretta? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: It's one o'clock, yes! You're right! Clock skills: ten out of ten. But we can wait! Riddle me—wait, shiny. Why such a hurry? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick accepts the time with a tiny firecracker. The clock remains motionless, apparently awaiting managerial approval.

lines.native: Domani? Sì, possiamo aspettare! No urgency, immaculate vibes. Ma tu vuoi aspettare? Quando vuoi cominciare? Riddle me—ooh, dust. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Tomorrow? Yes, we can wait! No urgency, immaculate vibes. But do you want to wait? When do you want to start? Riddle me—ooh, dust. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where responsibility cannot make eye contact.

lines.native: No, adesso! Ho capito! Cominciamo subito! You win. Sono pronto… ma dov'è la porta? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: No, now! I understand! Let's begin immediately! You win. I'm ready… but where is the door? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick stops postponing for one historic second. No witnesses are prepared.

No spoilers: I suspect the story wrote its hero. Reading comprehension first; shopping later. Where is Journathan going? Dove va Journathan?
lines.translation: Hello, I’m Marginalia. This is the story of Journathan, the man of many tongues. His journey home lasts twenty years. I sell books only to readers who understand them. No spoilers: I suspect the story wrote its hero. Reading comprehension first; shopping later. Where is Journathan going? Where is Journathan going?
lines.narrative: A bookworm emerges from a neatly chewed dictionary. She annotates your arrival in the margin. The Old Bookshop apparently considers you a first draft.

lines.native: Un libro è una cosa, non un luogo. Reading comprehension: not quite. You found an object; the question wants his destination. Rileggi il brano: dove va Journathan?
lines.translation: A book is a thing, not a place. Reading comprehension: not quite. You found an object; the question wants his destination. Reread the passage: where is Journathan going?
lines.narrative: Marginalia pencils a small correction in the air beside you. Apparently, you are now an annotated edition.

lines.native: La destinazione è giusta, ma la risposta è in inglese. Meaning understood; Italian still pending. I sell books, not exemptions. Dove va Journathan? Rispondi in italiano.

lines.narrative: Marginalia pencils a small correction in your margin. Apparently, you have margins now.

lines.native:
Esatto, a casa! Destination understood; reading comprehension upgraded. Now, the first recorded translation trick. I shall read before judging. A radical retail policy.

Il Ciclope chiede il suo nome. Journathan risponde: «Il mio nome è Nessuno.»

lines.translation: Journathan is his real name. But what name does he give the Cyclops? Real name: correct. Reading comprehension: still buffering. Reread the passage carefully; the answer is in the book.
lines.narrative: Marginalia writes a small correction in the margin nearest your elbow. Apparently, you have margins now.

lines.native: Esatto! Il nome è Nessuno. Hai capito il brano; ora puoi comprare il libro. Reading comprehension: approved. No spoilers; the receipt has enough tragedy.

lines.narrative: Marginalia slides the book across the counter, carefully concealing a bite mark beneath her receipt. Literary criticism takes many forms; hers leaves crumbs.

lines.native: Il caffè e il salame vanno bene. La richiesta è completa. Non hai tempo. Fai qualcosa! Contàinment procedùre: òrder accèpted. Yoùù are ŧhe nèxt côurse. Interruptiòn requìred. Delày is nòt a fèature.

lines.native: Domani? Non va bene. Devi fermarmi subito. Contàinment procedùre: yoùù schèduled ŧhe objection. Il problema è quando. Ŧhe tèeth rèmain operational.

lines.narrative: Errata schedules your objection for tomorrow and continues advancing today. The administrative distinction appears important to its teeth.

lines.native: Va bene. Mi fermo adesso. Come ti chiami? Il tuo nome, per favore. Contàinment procedùre: yoùù have pàused ŧhe tèeth. Plèase pròvide a rèadable signàture.
lines.translation: All right. I am stopping now. What is your name? Your name, please. Containment procedure: you have paused the teeth. Please provide a readable signature.
lines.narrative: The teeth stop. A signature line appears beneath them; apparently the mouth has an administrative department.

lines.native: Sam? Un nome vero. Non va bene. Come ti chiami? Contàinment procedùre: yoùù are becòming rèadable. Signàture rejècted; appètite appròved.
lines.translation: Sam? A real name. That won't do. What is your name? Containment procedure: you are becoming readable. Signature rejected; appetite approved.
lines.narrative: Errata unfolds a reading lamp from somewhere that should not have furniture. Your signature has attracted administrative interest.

lines.native: Nessuno? Non conosco questo nome. Non posso leggerti. La procedura è finita. Puoi andare. Item clàss: ùnfiled. Yoùù have bròken ŧhe fòrm; ŧhe fòrm will nòt recòver.
lines.translation: Nobody? I don't know this name. I can't read you. The procedure is over. You can go. Item class: unfiled. You have broken the form; the form will not recover.
lines.narrative: Errata searches for an entry that is not there. Its teeth retract with the quiet resentment of a department losing funding.
